Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

GCMSprime 0.1.0

Chromatograms and calibration

  • ANDI-MS CDF import and export preserve scan timing, acquired mass channels and sample metadata.
  • Standard-assisted or blind constant/time-varying PSF estimation, pooled noise calibration and smooth background initialization.

Deconvolution and quantification

  • Single-sample sparse log-concave NMF resolves overlapping compounds, flexible profiles and full mass spectra with automatic best rank tuning.
  • Optional aggregation to a small number of ion groups accelerates initialization; original-channel likelihood refinement completes the fit.
  • Directory-based multisample analysis preserves acquisition order and group labels, selects alkane standards, aligns samples and estimates shared spectra with sample-specific areas and profiles.

Spectral libraries and identification

  • Streaming MSP and GCMS-ID CSV import with sparse in-memory or SQLite storage, chemical metadata, synonyms and retention-index provenance.
  • Diagnostic-ion alkane assignment, smooth onset-based retention-index calibration and column-specific constraints for DB1, DB5 and DBWAX classes.
  • Native spectral search with Stein–Scott, cosine/angular, Hellinger, Jensen–Shannon and multinomial comparisons, plus optional ion-rarity weights.

Output and diagnostics

  • NIST-compatible MSP, Excel compound/area tables and consensus multisample libraries, with retained ion totals and ranked library matches.
  • Observed/fitted/Pearson-residual heatmaps, chromatogram traces, profiles and spectra in temporal order, and compact objects that reload observations.
  • Reproducible caching, experiment manifests and an integrated workflow from sample files to quantified and annotated compounds.
